findings.reason: the node cannot demonstrate the translation it is asked for, and the deferred `p′`/`FF′` gap reaches §4 unmeasured because this done-when never exercises it.
findings.text: done-when (1) requires `PlasmaSource.from_mast` to translate COCOS 3 to COCOS 17, but §3's own body (line 60) says the MAST flux rows' declared factor "equals today's `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR`" so "their values are unchanged for every caller", sends `p′` and `FF′` through raw and defers that 2π gap to §4, and names no `q` row on that route — so the mechanism changes no value a reader can observe and the clause cannot fail

findings.reason: the node is told both to keep the guard and to show its search returns nothing, so it must either weaken the search or drop the guard; without a stated exemption for the guard re-expressed against `nova_cocos.convention(17)` the clause is unsound as written.
findings.text: done-when (2) asserts that "§1's sign search, run again, finds no fixed-orientation sign test or `# COCOS` sign site in any reader", yet §3's body (line 59) keeps `prescribe`'s test (`span * I_p >= 0`, `nova/imas/plasma_source.py:76`), which §1's own census close recorded as "the only fixed-orientation sign test in the tree" — the search cannot return empty while that guard stands
